
```{r setup, include=FALSE}

model <- readRDS(here::here("data/model_rf.rds"))

#new table indices 
# Select the drought vegetation indices
# Change formulas to match the satellite data 

# vi <- read.csv(here::here("data/selected_spectral_indices_table.csv"))

#change formulas 

# Load the spectral indices file
# # select the indices used for drought monitoring
#select also NDWI
#change application domain t vegetation 
vi <- read_csv(here::here("data/spectral-indices-table.csv")) |>
  filter(short_name %in% c("NDVI", "EVI", "ARVI", "SAVI", "GVMI", "NDDI", "NDGI", "GNDWI", "RVI", "MSI", "NDWI")) |>
  select(short_name, formula, application_domain)|>
  mutate(
    application_domain = if_else(short_name == "NDWI", "vegetation", application_domain)
  )

#add new indices from literature
new_indices <- tibble(
  short_name = c("VSDI", "SIRR", "LSWI"),
  formula = c("1 - ((S1 - B) + (R - B))", "S1/S2", "(N - S1) / (N + S1)"),
  application_domain = c("vegetation", "vegetation", "vegetation"))
#   # # Find and update the GRVI formula
#   
vi <- vi %>%
  mutate(formula = ifelse(short_name == "RVI", "N / R", formula),
         #formula = ifelse(short_name == "NDGI", "(N - G) / (N + G)", formula),
         #formula = ifelse(short_name == "LSWI", "(N - S1) / (N + S1)", formula),
         formula = ifelse(short_name == "ARVI", "(N - 2*R + B) / (N + 2*R - B)", formula))
#          
# #new data 
vi <- bind_rows(vi, new_indices)
# 
write_csv(vi, here::here("data/selected_spectral_indices_table.csv"))



df <- readRDS(
  here::here("data/machine_learning_training_data.rds")
) |>
  rename(
    # NR_B1 = Nadir_Reflectance_Band1,
    # NR_B2 = Nadir_Reflectance_Band2,
    # NR_B3 = Nadir_Reflectance_Band3,
    # NR_B4 = Nadir_Reflectance_Band4,
    # NR_B5 = Nadir_Reflectance_Band5,
    # NR_B6 = Nadir_Reflectance_Band6,
    # NR_B7 = Nadir_Reflectance_Band7,
    # LST = LST_Day_1km
  ) |>
  drop_na(
    starts_with("NR_"),
    starts_with("LST"),
    ends_with("_era5")
  )

vi <- calc_VI(df, indices = here::here("data/selected_spectral_indices_table.csv"))
df <- bind_cols(df, vi)

preds <- model$pred
preds$site <- df$site[preds$rowIndex]
preds$date <- df$date[preds$rowIndex]
colnames(preds)

#check if preds flue obs value are same as df flue values 
preds_filtered <- preds %>%
  filter(site == "AR-Vir") %>%
  select(site, date,obs, pred)

#they are same>> merge datasets by date and site 

# merge by site and date 
#combined is dataset with ml dataframe only for preds rowindex 
# plus vegetations indices calculated for these rows 
combined <- dplyr::left_join(df,preds,
                             by = c("site", "date"))



#read in precompiled model
model <- readRDS(
  here::here("data/model_rf.rds")
)

# run the model on our test data
# using predict()
df1 <- combined|>
  dplyr::select(obs,pred)

# df <- data.frame(
#   test,
#   flue_predicted = test_results
# )

# ## regression metrics
df1|>
  yardstick::metrics(
    truth = obs,
    estimate = pred
  ) |>
  rename(
    metric = .metric,
    value  = .estimate
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    metric,
    value
  ) |>
  mutate(
    value = round(value, 3)
  ) |>
  reactable::reactable()

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

Comparing VI versus fLUE

```{r echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

df2 <- combined |>
  dplyr::select(
    -starts_with("NR"),
    -starts_with("LST"),
    - ends_with("_era5"),
    -mtry, -splitrule, -rowIndex, -Resample, -min.node.size, -obs
  )
colnames(df2)

max(df2$flue)
max(df2$flue_predicted)
max(df2$NDVI)

df_long <- df2 |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 7:ncol(df2),
    names_to = "index",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(value),
    !is.infinite(value)
  )

# rsq <- df_long |>
#   group_by(cluster, index, site) |>
#   do({
#   
#     rsq <- summary(lm(flue ~ value, data = .))$r.squared
#     
#     data.frame(rsq)
#     
#   }) |>
#   mutate(
#     flue = ifelse(index == "flue_predicted", TRUE, FALSE)
#   )

rsq <- df_long |>
  group_by(cluster, index, site) |>
  do({
    rsq <- summary(lm(flue ~ value, data = .))$r.squared
    data.frame(rsq)
  }) |>
  mutate(
    flue = ifelse(index == "pred", "fLUE_predicted", "VI"),
    index = ifelse(index == "pred", "fLUE_pred", index))|>
  drop_na()

```


```{r echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# plot all validation graphs
p <- ggplot(rsq) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(
      cluster,
      rsq,
      fill = flue
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic()

p <- ggplot(rsq) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(
      cluster,
      rsq,
      fill = flue
    ),
    color = "black", # Add black border around the boxes
    # outlier.color = "red", # Customize outlier color
    outlier.shape = 16 # Use a filled circle for outliers
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("fLUE_predicted" = "#E69F00", "VI" = "#999999" ) # Custom colors for flue and index
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) + # Use a minimal theme with larger base font size
  ylab("R²") +  # Adding y-axis label
  xlab("Cluster") + # Adding x-axis label
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.8, 0.8), 
    legend.text = element_text(size=18),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # Removes major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    # Place legend inside the plot
    # legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"), # Add a border to the legend
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text( size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size= 16),
    # axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 11)# Change axis text color to black
    #axis.title = element_text(face = "bold") # Make axis titles bold
  ) +
  labs(fill = "")

print(p)
```

Which one performs best?


only cDD and cGR



```{r}
best_ind <- rsq |> 
  filter(!cluster %in% c("cNA", "cLS")) |> 
  group_by(index) |> 
  summarise(rsq = median(rsq)) |> 
  arrange(desc(rsq)) |> 
  # dplyr::slice(1:10) |> 
  pull(index)

cluster_labels <- rsq |> 
  filter(index %in% best_ind, !cluster %in% c("cNA", "cLS")) |> 
  group_by(cluster) |> 
  summarise(rsq = max(rsq) * 0.9) 


# Create the plot
p1 <- rsq |> 
  filter(index %in% best_ind, !cluster %in% c("cNA", "cLS"))|> 
  mutate(index = fct_reorder(index, rsq, .fun = "mean")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(index, desc(rsq)), y = rsq, fill = flue)) +
  
  # Boxplot with custom colors
  geom_boxplot(color = "black", outlier.color = "black", outlier.shape = 16) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0), 
              size = 3, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
  
  # Facet wrap for clusters
  facet_wrap(~cluster, nrow = 10) +
  # scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("fLUE_predicted" = "#B57114", "VI" = "#706513")) +  
  
  # Background shading for the first facet
  theme_bw(base_size = 14, base_rect_size = 0.8) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # Removes major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),# Removes minor grid line# Remove facet titles
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 13), 
    axis.text.y = element_text( size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size= 14), 
    axis.title.y = element_text(size= 20),# Rotate x-axis labels
    legend.position = "none" # Remove legend
  ) +
  
  # Add cluster labels inside the plot using a separate dataset
  geom_text(data = cluster_labels, 
            aes(x = 12, y = 0.8, label = cluster), # Adjust x-position for readability
            inherit.aes = FALSE, 
            color = "black", size = 7, fontface = "bold") +
  
  # Labels
  labs(x = NULL, y = "R²")   

print(p1)


ggsave("fig/flue_VI_cdd_cgr.png", width =11, height = 12 , dpi =700)

```
